great_silence.sub: What follows is leisure you chose.

trash.sub: It has to go out tonight — on an improv Tuesday, before you leave.

dog.sub: 30 min. First on purpose — it carries the transition.

groceries.sub: 45 min, if needed — you're already out.

gym.sub: 45 min. Floor of 3 a week; Saturday's trainer counts.

meds.sub: Right after you are up. Most time-sensitive item of the day.

sync.sub: Open Claude Code, run /ordo. Before the first work session.

weight.sub: Before breakfast, and before anything to drink.

dog_2.sub: Improv Tuesdays only — before you leave, because 5:30 is departure prep and 9:30 is late for him.

review.prompt: What happened, plainly. Drinks are already counted — nothing to judge.
review.title: Review

shame_check.prompt: Name the feeling. Then: is that the act, or the person? Judge the act. Pardon the person.
shame_check.title: The shame check

wins.prompt: What you did. Actions, not outcomes.
wins.title: Wins
